findings.description: Debt timeline interpolation on sparse days requires horizontal step-hold rather than linear interpolation to avoid misleading daily values.
findings.recommendation: Use step-line rendering in ObservableDebtTimelineChart CustomPainter.

findings.description: When an expense is recorded for another member, any selected personal wallet must be nullified to prevent erroneous personal cash deduction.
findings.recommendation: Enforce walletId = null whenever paidBy != currentUserId.

findings.description: Filtering hundreds of items in ExpenseList could cause jank if executed repeatedly during rebuilds.
findings.recommendation: Encapsulate filter state in ValueNotifier or memoized list.
